purpose: Teach: 菅野/岩国/西宮/さいたま/前川/河村/鎌田/北川

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の菅野先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — take on the research that your mentor Professor Sugano has been doing.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Clear syllable weight on 'Ren.' Pause after the name—giving him space to listen. Quiet authority, not harsh. The tone of someone who knows what matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。岩国基地周辺の社会学論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the sociology papers on the Iwakuni base area.
lines.style: Soft, careful affirmation. Slight breath before the task—absorbing the weight of it. Steady pace, no hesitation. The voice of someone taking note of what matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の西宮先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — contact Professor Nishimiya from the collaborative research group and request guidance.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful. Light emphasis on the task itself. Same measured authority as the first line. Not rushing him—trusting he's following.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。さいたま大学の助教の発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll attend the assistant professor's presentation at Saitama University.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Small pause before the specific detail—showing he's taking this down. Even tempo. The voice of careful note-taking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の前川先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren — also use Professor Maekawa's papers from the literature as reference.
lines.style: Continued steady direction. Same calm authority. Light tap of emphasis on 'also'—layering one more piece into the task. No rush, no pressure in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の河村先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask Senior Kawamura in the lab for guidance on that.
lines.style: Respectful, measured. Slight lengthening on the senior's name—showing proper deference. Unhurried pace. The voice of someone building a plan step by step.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の鎌田教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren — set up a meeting with Professor Kamada from the international partnership.
lines.style: Same assured direction. Clear weight on the task. The final item, but no shift in tone—this matters as much as the others. Steady to the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、北川事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the application to Ms. Kitakawa, the research fund administrator.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Slight gathering of focus on the administrative detail. Small, satisfied breath-quality—he's closing the loop, showing competence. Quiet completion.
